text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Man, this is bad... I'm going to the 
movies with a pal soon, and it turns out 
it's one of those gimmick theaters where 
the seats move and water sprays at you...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
When I first moved to the big city and 
experienced that, I was so shocked I 
couldn't stop yelling out loud! Like, 
"Whoa!" and "Whaaat!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Because the chair was moving so much I 
thought I'd get thrown off! And anyone 
would yell if water got splashed on them 
out of nowhere, right?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Still, it'd be a bother to the people 
around me... Hmm... Guess I'll just have 
to hold my breath while watching?
